name: Sensei
source:
Homeroom teacher of [url=/c13087]Akiko[/url]'s class; a young women in her late 20's. As a teacher she is a little a little unreliable, she often sighs. She gives out the impression of her having a low confidence.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ensemble-game.com/01.hanaotome/chara.html]the official site[/url].]
